newsitem.title: USA: SBC Communications markets landline long distance.
newsitem.headline: SBC Communications markets landline long distance.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc said Monday that it began marketing land line long-distance service to its Cellular One customers in the greater Chicago, Boston and Washington, D.C., metro areas, as well as upstate New York and central Illinois.
SBC Communications said Cellular One can now provide residents and businesses with wireless local and long distance service, paging, Internet access and land line long-distance services.
SBC said the land line long distance service is part of its "one-stop shopping" strategy to be a single source for telecommunications services.
